purpose: Evidence-convergence gate for canonical skeleton targets. Prevent a single population, method or measurement definition from being promoted directly into production anatomy.

grading.A: Confirmed structural/proportion finding: hard anatomy/geometry failure OR at least two substantially measurement-compatible independent sources converge on the same direction.
grading.B: Strongly supported/reopen: multiple clues agree but endpoint, stature, population or method mismatch prevents an exact target.
grading.C: Conflicted/insufficient: credible sources disagree materially or do not match the modeled measurement; no directional geometry change may be frozen.
grading.D: Unreviewed/placeholder: topology exists but geometry has not been independently validated.

freeze_policy: A dimensional target may not be frozen from one population mean alone.
For a RED dimensional change, require two independent measurement-compatible sources OR one source plus a hard geometric invariant.
When sources use different endpoints, store both and map endpoints before comparing numbers.
Stature-aware evidence outranks an unmatched population mean when the intended character stature is fixed.
A source conflict downgrades the finding until resolved; do not average incompatible definitions.
Structural invariants such as 'disc-bearing levels require a nonzero disc space' do not need population averaging.
All audit corrections remain in history; corrected conclusions replace, not erase, earlier overclaims.
